signals.text: 3 open PM roles across 1 US office
1 new PM role posted this week

news.title: Valon raises $150m Series D at $2.3bn valuation
Valon raises $150M from a16z and others at $2.3B valuation to bring AI agents to the mortgage market
Valon Raises $150M for AI-Native Mortgage Servicing Platform

bullets: Act as a mortgage servicing subject matter expert to help shape business requirements that ultimately become product features.
Engage with clients across the deployment cycle — from sales demos to enablement to product support.
Serve as a product expert; educate clients on how to use Valon’s system successfully.
Understand client needs and tailor solutions that drive measurable outcomes.
Collaborate with tech teams (Product, Engineering, Ops) to translate feedback into feature requests and platform improvements.
Develop and manage a cohesive product roadmap, prioritize features that deliver measurable business outcomes for our SaaS customers
Write clear, comprehensive PRDs and specifications that eliminate ambiguity for engineering
Deeply understand customer and user needs across internal servicing teams and external partners (e.g., law firms, vendors) and translate them into clear product requirements
Manage timelines and dependencies; make decisive trade-offs between speed, scope, and technical quality
Ensure successful rollouts in partnership with Deployment Strategy and Product Operations
Define and own the roadmap for one or more core infrastructure domains (such as notification platform, documents platform, user management, etc.)
Deeply engage with internal stakeholders (engineering leads, vertical PMs, operations) and our customers to drive discovery and specification.
Drive initiatives end-to-end: from ideation, discovery, scoping, to launch, adoption, and iteration.
Work directly with customers/stakeholders (sometimes on-site at their operations) so that your deliverables are finely tuned to their unique and complex processes
Ensure infrastructure is resilient, scalable, observable, and secure — balancing performance, reliability, and long-term extensibility.
